title: Premise, Arc, Phase, Chapter & Open-World Structure
objective: Extend the MAS Adventure-authoring workspace with deterministic structural representations for premise, arc, phase, chapter and open-world organization while preserving MAS-01 authority boundaries and supporting linear, branching, sandbox and hybrid Adventure structures without treating prepared structure as live runtime state.

scope.purpose: Represent Adventure premise and higher-order structural organization inside the MAS workspace without forcing a single story shape or taking canonical Story/Adventure/runtime authority.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS Adventure workspace can deterministically express premise, arcs, phases, chapters and open-world structural groupings, including non-linear/sandbox forms, while remaining prepared authoring structure rather than live runtime truth and without duplicating canonical Story/Adventure/CNI owner authority.

selection_boundaries: Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition is authorized or required.
MAS-01 workspace/document and authority boundaries remain foundational and are not reopened silently.
MAS supports linear, branching, node-based, sandbox and hybrid structures; MAS-02 must not impose a golden-path or mandatory linear hierarchy.
Prepared structural definitions remain distinct from live occurrences and canonical runtime state.
CSW remains pre-authoritative creative/storycraft workspace; CNI and owner domains retain their existing runtime/state authorities.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-03+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: On the authorized application branch, establish causal MAS-02 RED against deterministic premise/arc/phase/chapter/open-world structure and then implement the minimum contract without reopening MAS-01 authority boundaries.
